delete.description: Signs the device out everywhere; its queued events are refused from then on.

post.description: The code from the link the launcher opened (URL fragment), traded for a session.
Ten new codes; the old ones stop working. Shown once: the learner keeps them somewhere safe.
Redeem the one-time setup code from the server's log; then add a passkey or a password.

A second start of Yuo while it runs: the launcher asks this one for a new sign-in link. Public
route, guarded by the control token from the data folder (readable by this user only).

A signed-out tab: open Yuo signed in, in a new tab of this computer's browser. Public route; it
only makes the server open a fresh sign-in link locally, so the caller learns nothing.
With sign-in on, the device is the session's (made at sign-in); this returns it.

post.description: Open the checkpoint: the questions and the quiz are written.
The quiz and the direction answers: the directions are written.
The learner confirms a direction: its branches are written and added to the path.
Close the checkpoint without changes.
None of the directions fits: different ones are written.
Run the failed writing step again.
